name: Moving On
overview: Scripture encourages believers to move on from past struggles and trust in God's sovereign care and strength. As Isaiah 43:18 exhorts, we are to forget former things and not dwell on the past, while Isaiah 40:29 reminds us that God renews strength for the faint. Trusting in the Lord’s protection and peace, as in Exodus 14:14 and Psalms 91:1, empowers us to face the future confidently, assured that God's plans for us are good and filled with hope (Jeremiah 29:11). This movement forward requires discernment to avoid deception, as Matthew 7:15 warns against false teachers who might hinder our spiritual progress.
